name: Underhanded Blow
body:
You use your guile to deliver devastating strikes.

Prerequisite: Int 15, Weapon Finesse, Sneak Attack +2d6

Benefit: When using Weapon Finesse, you can choose to add your intelligence modifier to damage rolls instead of your strength modifier. This modifier is not increased for two handed weapons, but it is not reduced for off-hand weapons.

Special: A rogue may select this feat as a rogue talent.
